title: Quran mode
changes: The Quran's 105 most common roots, most common first, at the top of Campaigns.
Roots you learn in any campaign count on the Quran list too: they're the same cards.
Switch on "Quran first" (in Campaigns or Settings) to learn the Quran's roots before anything else.
50 new roots that the Quran uses often, each with its words.

title: Smarter reviews, 50 more roots and 13,000 sentences
changes: Reviews are now scheduled with FSRS, the algorithm Anki uses: fewer reviews for the same memory. Each grade button shows when the card will come back.
Five new campaigns, 50 more roots: Faith & Tradition, Language & Speech, Days & Seasons, Numbers & Measures, Arts & Leisure.
The sentence explorer now has about 13,700 sentences, most of them from Tatoeba, all using words you can learn here.
Fixed the spelling of several roots and merged a root that appeared twice. Your progress on them carries over.
Hear roots and letters said by their letter names.

title: More roots, lessons, stories and a sentence explorer
changes: Five new campaigns, 50 more roots: Body & Health, Travel & Places, Feelings & Character, Mind & Will, City & Media.
Lessons: short cards on how Arabic builds words from roots, each appearing once you have met enough examples. Find them again under Lessons in the sidebar.
Stories: a famous story of Arab culture after each campaign, told with the words you just learned. They live under Stories in the sidebar.
Sentence explorer: search the sentences, with every word you are studying underlined in the colour of how well you know it.
Open the Sentences section on any word or root to see it used.
Works fully offline, and syncs by itself the moment you are back online.
Faster first launch.
Arabic Decoded now runs in the browser too, offline included.

title: Stats, sidebar and collections
changes: A sidebar with your account, learning stats, settings, About and these updates.
Learning stats: how many cards you know at each level, by day, month or year, plus your streak.
Hold any card to add it to your queue, mark it mastered, favorite it, reset it or file it in a collection.
Collections: your own lists of cards, with a practice mode that doesn't affect your schedule.
In Campaigns, hold a tile to select several cards and act on them together.
An Alphabet section for complete beginners: the 28 letters as cards, with their sounds and shapes.
A daily goal and your streak on the welcome card.
Favorites, collections and your review history now sync with your account.
Sentences, in the sidebar: browse everyday sentences and add the ones you want to your queue.
Choose the Arabic font in Settings.

title: Words, patterns and listening
changes: Every root now has its words as cards of their own, with meanings and example sentences.
Words link back to their root, and a root lists the words built from it.
Pattern cards explain the shapes words are built on.
A welcome card on opening the app: what's due today and how far along you are.
Listen to any card read aloud while you're online.
Accounts: sign in to back up your progress and sync it between devices.

title: More campaigns
changes: Ten themed campaigns of roots, from Absolute Core to Abstract Concepts.
Root tiles in Campaigns are coloured by how well you know them.

title: First version
changes: Roots as flashcards on a spaced-repetition schedule, with a dictionary to browse them.
